summary: About 90 concurrent authenticated users stayed healthy (fail 1.2%, p95 74ms). Comfortable target: ~70 concurrent active users. Scheduled peak was 150 VUs — auth signup capped successful sessions at 90.
notes: Mix: feed + profile + chat + search + ~20% post create, with 1–3s think time
Auth /register is the first bottleneck under burst signup
Once logged in, API p95 stayed under ~100ms through the ramp
Concurrent active users ≠ total registered users; DAU can be much higher
